title: Chinese Tyre Shipments to Russia Doubled in a Year
subtitle: June deliveries of passenger car tyres reached 2.99 million units worth 85 million dollars, strengthening the case in Moscow for anti-dumping duties.

source.name: Chinese customs data on tyre exports to Russia reported by Kommersant

data.label: June 2026
data.annotation: Value doubled in parallel, reaching 85 million dollars.

supportingFacts.label: The scale of the increase raises the probability that Russia introduces duties against Chinese tyre dumping.

metadata.keyFinding: Chinese passenger tyre exports to Russia doubled to 2.99 million units in June 2026.
